summary: CR-561 Gap A (APS price entry in the Accept pop-up) FAILED on the live test, and I applied a one-line fix that is NOT yet retested. Login worked and the ScanOrderPopOut opened for order #1579043 (t2, Order 1 of 1, ₹102.00). The 'melo fish' row rendered the price input data-testid='popout-item-price-input-3969980' in place of the 'Price TBD' badge (PASS). I typed 250 (input value '250'), waited 1s and clicked popout-accept-btn. Only one write request was sent: PUT /api/v2/vendoremployee/order/waiter-dinein-order-status-update {order_id:'1579043', order_status:'cooking'} -> 200. The PUT /api/v2/vendoremployee/order/update-food-item-price was NEVER sent. The order was accepted and the pop-out closed with no error toast, but the price was lost silently. Persistence check (FAIL): in OrderEntry for t2, both 'melo fish' lines still show ₹1 and Collect Bill is still ₹102. RCA: in ScanOrderPopOut.jsx handleAcceptClick, the useCallback deps were [onAccept, isAccepting] and did not include pendingPrices. Typing only re-renders the pop-out, so the callback kept the stale {} from mount and priceItems was always empty. Fix applied: deps changed to [onAccept, isAccepting, pendingPrices]; it compiles. It could not be retested because #1579043 is now accepted and no other order in the queue has an APS price input (count 0). The 'leave blank -> accept with no price call' path behaved correctly (in effect this is what happened).

critical_code_review_comments: ScanOrderPopOut.jsx handleAcceptClick: missing pendingPrices in the useCallback deps caused the bug (the eslint react-hooks warning would have flagged it). Fixed.

PopoutItemRow priceDraft is local state keyed only by row mount. pendingPrices is cleared on order switch, but if PopoutItemRow instances are reused across orders (key = itemId ?? id) a stale draft value could show. This is low risk because keys differ per line.
If the price PUT succeeds and onAccept then fails, the user gets no visible error. Clicking again re-sends the price (idempotent, so acceptable).
The price-save failure path only logs to the console. Add an error toast.
